25: class ConvGRU(nn.Module):
26:     def __init__(self, hidden_dim=128, input_dim=192 + 128):
27:         super(ConvGRU, self).__init__()
28:         self.convz = nn.Conv2d(hidden_dim + input_dim, hidden_dim, 3, padding=1)
29:         self.convr = nn.Conv2d(hidden_dim + input_dim, hidden_dim, 3, padding=1)
30:         self.convq = nn.Conv2d(hidden_dim + input_dim, hidden_dim, 3, padding=1)
31: 
32:     def forward(self, h, x):
33:         hx = torch.cat([h, x], dim=1)
34: 
35:         z = torch.sigmoid(self.convz(hx))
36:         r = torch.sigmoid(self.convr(hx))
37:         q = torch.tanh(self.convq(torch.cat([r * h, x], dim=1)))
38: 
39:         h = (1 - z) * h + z * q
40:         return h
